entities.name: Muhammad ibn Buzurg-Ummid
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Muḥammad ibn Buzurg-Ummīd was the son of Kiyā Buzurg-Ummīd, and the third ruler of the Nizari Ismailis from 1138 until 1162 based in Alamut.
